items.name: GENERATOR_KINDS
items.doc: The generator kinds, in surface order: its position is the integer omx-dsp's omx_gen_fill takes as its kind (OMX_GEN_OSC, OMX_GEN_WHITE, OMX_GEN_PINK).

items.name: WAVEFORMS
items.doc: The selectable oscillator waveforms, in surface order: its position is the integer omx-dsp's omx_gen_osc takes (OMX_WAVE_SINE, OMX_WAVE_SQUARE, OMX_WAVE_SAW, OMX_WAVE_TRIANGLE).
